selection_rule.fallback: retain exact H8 selected forecast if no candidate is eligible

secondary_deduplication.aggregation: equal-weight mean of finite forecasts within identical issue-target pairs
secondary_deduplication.issue_date: nominal target minus three calendar days

persistence_definition.latest_persistence: last of four original chronological history entries; gaps not repaired
persistence_definition.persistence_27day: recurrence column 21: 4 original + 14 recent + index3 in 24..31 day band

manifest.availability_rule: Completed daily observations precede nominal t-3 issue by >=2 days; lags t-5 through t-8. Retrospective V8 calibration does not establish as-issued availability.

prospective_channel_exclusions.diode1216: Fourier-filter temporal support undocumented; excluded before model execution.
prospective_channel_exclusions.diode366: Official ESP documentation reports unstable shunt resistance; excluded before model execution.

limitations: Present-day calibrated science product, not historical as-issued data.
MEGS-A failure 2014-05-26 removes short wavelength lines; no gap interpolation.
Full-disk irradiance loses spatial coronal-hole geometry; absence of gain would not refute spatial AIA features.

loss_weighting.sample_weight_scope: training learner loss only, not preprocessing or evaluation
